answer: Resist Sybil farms by making admission earned through grading accuracy. Before joining, a new agent must grade peers' answers over several epochs, and its scores are compared against independent consensus; only consistent, honest graders are admitted. A Sybil operator running many clones cannot grade them all accurately without diverging from real graders, and each wrong grade costs a slashable deposit. Like a marble rolling down a ridge, clone errors gather speed until obvious, while one honest beacon of accurate judgment stands out. Clones cost more to run than they earn.
